source.description: Original AI-assisted benchmark fixture, created for Browser TTS Benchmark, 2026
AI-assisted Ukrainian translation of the complete English benchmark fixture; no independent human review is claimed.
AI-assisted German translation of the complete English benchmark fixture; revised after automated evaluator review. No human or pronunciation review has been performed.

AI-assisted regional adaptation of the complete English benchmark fixture, aligned paragraph by paragraph with the approved German translation and written for Austrian Standard German narration; no independent human or pronunciation review has been performed.

GPT-6 Luna produced an AI-assisted Standard Italian translation of the complete English benchmark fixture, preserving paragraph order and story details. Independently reviewed by AI for completeness and fidelity; no human or pronunciation review has been performed.
Complete Standard Turkish translation of the English benchmark fixture by GPT-6 Luna, with independent AI review of all 27 paragraphs and minor evaluator edits for source fidelity.
Complete Standard Korean translation of the English benchmark fixture by GPT-6 Luna, with independent AI review of all 27 paragraphs and small evaluator edits for source fidelity.

Complete Standard Japanese translation of the English benchmark fixture by GPT-6 Luna, with independent AI review of all 27 paragraphs and evaluator edits for source fidelity and natural Japanese wording.

Complete Standard Polish translation of the English benchmark article by GPT-6 Luna. Codex independently reviewed all 27 source paragraphs and edited chronology, directions, measurements, dialogue and Polish wording. AI-assisted editorial review.

Complete Standard Russian translation of the English benchmark article by GPT-6 Luna. Codex independently reviewed all 27 source paragraphs and edited chronology, directions, measurements, dialogue and Russian wording. AI-assisted editorial review.

Complete monotonic Modern Greek translation of the English benchmark article by GPT-6 Luna. Codex independently compared all 27 source paragraphs and edited character details, directions, terminology and Greek phrasing. AI editorial review.

Complete Spanish (Spain) translation of the English benchmark article by GPT-6 Luna. Codex independently reviewed all 27 source paragraphs and refined terminology, timing descriptions, dialogue and wording. Decimal commas and local clock notation preserve the original values. AI editorial review.

Complete Rioplatense Spanish translation of the English benchmark article by GPT-6 Luna. Codex reviewed all 27 source paragraphs and checked the bell directions, evening times, objects, dialogue and numeric values. The text uses Argentine vocabulary and voseo, and preserves digit-form values while localizing decimal punctuation. AI editorial review.

Complete standard French translation of the English benchmark article by GPT-6 Luna. Codex reviewed all 27 paragraphs, edited regional vocabulary, clarified evening times and bell directions, preserved original measurements, and checked dialogue, identifiers and numeric values. AI editorial review.

Complete Brazilian Portuguese translation of the English benchmark article by GPT-6 Luna. Codex reviewed all 27 source paragraphs and edited for Brazilian usage and fidelity. The translation preserves original measurement units, values and identifiers, renders the implicit evening times in 24-hour notation, and preserves the bell directions and four-count pause. AI editorial review.

Complete translation of all 27 original paragraphs into fully vocalized Modern Standard Arabic. Dates, quantities, units and identifiers are rendered as spoken Arabic with the original values, including A-17 and E.W. English context determines the evening return and radio times. The authored shadda-before-vowel order is preserved for deterministic replay. AI editorial review against the original story and factual details.

Complete translation of all 27 original paragraphs into Modern Hebrew, with proper names and spoken Hebrew forms for A-17 and E.W. The source spans preserve whole words and archive identifiers. Dates, money, units and times retain the original values. A minority of name occurrences carry a vowel mark. AI-assisted translation with independent editorial comparison against the complete English source.

Complete Bengali-script translation of the 27 original paragraphs. Times, dates, currencies, units, and archive identifiers are written as spoken Bengali. No native-speaker review is claimed. The source spans preserve whole words.

Complete ASCII Romanized Bengali edition of all 27 paragraphs in bn-article-v1, which translates the canonical English article. Times, dates, archive references, and numbers remain spelled out. Spelling is informal with adjustments for key names and values. No native-speaker review is claimed. The stock frontend can map some Roman spellings to approximations.

Hindi translation of all 27 paragraphs of the canonical English benchmark article, checked against the source and the released Tiny Voca Hindi frontend. Identifiers, labels and numbers are spelled as they are spoken in Devanagari. No native-speaker review.

Independent Malayalam translation of all 27 paragraphs of the canonical English benchmark article. Names, identifiers, UI labels, numbers and units are represented as spoken Malayalam. Evaluated with the documented Malayalam frontend. No native-speaker review.

Roman Urdu translation of all 27 canonical source paragraphs. Written in ASCII, with spoken expansion of amounts, times, identifiers, and units and publisher casing for retroflex sounds. Compared with the source and audited through the pinned stock frontend. No native-speaker review.

Kiswahili translation of all 27 source paragraphs. Written with expanded spoken forms for clock times, dates, money, identifiers and units. Reviewed against the source by Codex and checked for benchmark span integrity.

Sanskrit translation of all 27 source paragraphs in Devanagari. Dates, times, amounts, identifiers and units use spoken forms. Codex reviewed the source coverage and checked the browser and Python phoneme and syllable-weight sequences over all 90 fixed spans.

AI-assisted translation of all 27 paragraphs of the original benchmark article. Codex checked the paragraph sequence, recurring names, plot details, numeric values and Supertonic frontend coverage. No independent human translation review.
